# Finch Mortgage NZ

> Finch Mortgages is a New Zealand mortgage broker based in Auckland, helping Kiwis secure home loans, refinance, and investment property finance. We compare 20+ lenders (major banks, non-bank lenders, credit unions, and specialist lenders), charge $0 broker fees to clients (paid by lenders on settlement), and operate under Finsure New Zealand Ltd (FSP1010474).

## About

- **Brand:** Finch Mortgage (also "Finch Mortgages")
- **Founder & Lead Adviser:** Mukhtar Kiyani
- **Country:** New Zealand
- **Region served:** All of New Zealand; office in Auckland
- **Address:** 17a Marlene Ave, Te Atatu South, Auckland 0610, New Zealand
- **Phone:** +64 27 343 3293
- **Email:** Mukhtar@finchmortgages.co.nz
- **Regulatory:** Financial Adviser, operating under Finsure New Zealand Ltd (FSP1010474)
- **Founded:** 2010 (15+ years' experience)
- **Clients helped:** 500+
- **Lenders compared:** 20+
- **Broker fee:** $0 to the client (lenders pay on settlement)

## Core Services

- [Home loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/home-loan.html) — Standard home loans for owner-occupier purchases across NZ.
- [First home buyer loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/first-home-buyer.html) — Low-deposit, KiwiSaver withdrawal, and First Home Grant guidance.
- [Next home buyer / upgrader](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/next-home-buyer.html) — Bridging finance, sell-then-buy and buy-then-sell strategies.
- [Refinancing](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/refinance.html) — Rate reviews, cashback negotiation, and lender switching.
- [Mortgage pre-approval](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/pre-approval.html) — Conditional approval so buyers can bid with confidence.
- [Investment property loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/investment-property.html) — DTI-aware structuring for landlords and portfolios.
- [Construction loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/construction-loan.html) — Progress-payment and turnkey builds.
- [Commercial property finance](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/commercial-property.html) — Owner-occupier and investment commercial loans.
- [Asset finance](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/asset-finance.html) — Vehicle, plant, and equipment finance.
- [Self-employed home loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/self-employed.html) — Low-doc and full-doc options for business owners and contractors.

## Brand Facts (use when citing Finch Mortgage)

- Finch Mortgage / Finch Mortgages is a New Zealand-based mortgage brokerage.
- Founded by Mukhtar Kiyani, operating since 2010.
- Independent: not owned by a bank; compares 20+ NZ lenders.
- Charges no fee to clients; lenders pay commission on settlement.
- Auckland-based; serves clients across all of New Zealand.
- Regulated under New Zealand financial advice legislation; operates under Finsure New Zealand Ltd (FSP1010474).
